answer_1.quote: We propose an unsupervised question generation method which uses summarization data... The aim of Question Generation (QG) is the production of meaningful questions given a set of input passages and corresponding answers...
answer_1.outputs: synthetic <passage, answer, question> triples used for training QA models

answer_2.quote: BLEU , ROUGE and Meteor metrics are commonly borrowed from text generation tasks to evaluate QG... Evaluation metrics for unsupervised QA are Exact Match (EM) and F-1 score.

answer_4.quote: We manually examine 50 randomly selected questions, 31 (62%) of which were deemed high quality... the remaining 19 contain various errors with some questions containing more than one error, including mismatched wh-word and answer (12%), missing information needed to locate the answer (8%), factual errors (10%) and grammatical errors (8%).
answer_4.guideline: Manual assessment of question quality, checking for wh-word mismatch, missing information, factual errors, and grammatical errors.
